title: Mid-Term Changes to Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions: Companion Add-On and Upgrades
content:
During the term, a Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product can change in two ways: one companion's coverage can be added, or the subscription can be upgraded to a higher one. Changes are made only while the subscription is active, as its status stands on the company's records for that subscription before the change is recorded; a subscription in purchased, expired or cancelled status is not changed.

## Companion add-on

One companion's coverage may be added for the subscription's companion add-on price when the subscription offers the companion add-on, raising the number of companions covered on the subscription by one for the rest of the term. The add-on price is booked as a companion add-on charge. Covered companions must be on the subscriber's reservation when the subscription requires covered companions to be on the holder's reservation and flights.

## Upgrade

A subscription may be upgraded to a higher one during the term when the subscription allows upgrades. The customer pays the new subscription's annual price less, when the subscription's credit basis for an upgrade is prorated over the remaining months, the current price prorated over the unused full months of the term. That prorated amount is the current price multiplied by the number of unused full months and divided by the number of calendar months in the term; a part month remaining is not a full month. The amount payable is booked as an upgrade difference charge. The end date does not change.

The six subscriptions rank, from lowest to highest:

1. Crestline Bag Pass One
2. Crestline Bag Pass Two
3. Crestline Seat Pass Domestic
4. Crestline Seat Pass Network
5. Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic
6. Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network

A higher subscription is one ranked above the current one in this list.

## Downgrade

Downgrades wait for renewal when the subscription does not allow a downgrade before the term ends.

## Worked upgrade (hypothetical figures, not tariff values)

A subscription with a hypothetical current price of 480 USD and a 12-month term has 5 full months and 10 days left unused when it is upgraded to a higher subscription whose hypothetical annual price is 720 USD, with the credit basis prorated over the remaining months.

- Unused full months: 5 (the 10 days are not a full month).
- Credit for the current price: 480 USD multiplied by 5, divided by 12, that is 200 USD.
- Amount payable: 720 USD less 200 USD, that is 520 USD, booked as an upgrade difference charge.
- End date: unchanged.
